# Dilemma v3.8.1

New EXP exchanges require at least 3 Sparks. The rate is 3 EXP per Spark, so `/dilemma score exchange amount:3` gives 9 EXP. Requests for 1 or 2 Sparks leave the player's balance and EXP intact. A retry of an earlier successful exchange still returns its original receipt.

The Discord command and both player guides show the minimum. Re-register the commands when upgrading from v3.8.0. No database migration is required.
